A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SE-LLM research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables and appendices support comparison despite extensive reformatting.

before.justification: v4 reports original forecasting experiments, component ablations, efficiency measurements and three-seed stability results.

after.justification: v6 retains these original empirical studies, including the detailed results in Tables 9–16.

M1.justification: Eq. (7) changes the specified gated-fusion input from joint-space C to de-anomalized DA. This is a localized computational correction; the overall TSCC, AM-VAE, Time-Adapter and autoregressive pipeline remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same long-term datasets, ETT transfer experiments, M4 short-term forecasting and M3/M4 zero-shot frequency transfers. No evaluated dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: TimeMOE's ECL comparison is removed: its numerical entries become dashes in Tables 1 and 9, while its ETTh1 and Weather comparisons remain. Other comparator sets are retained. The corrected TimeMixer++ table headings refer to the same baseline already identified in v4.

E3.justification: The stated splits, horizons, metrics, model variants and timing batch/sequence lengths remain unchanged. v6 newly documents baseline input-length selection and a common timing environment, but does not establish that these existing evaluation procedures changed between versions.

E4.justification: The component, backbone, adapter and framework-transfer ablations are retained, as are the STL/t-SNE anomaly analysis and efficiency study. No new ablation, robustness test or case study appears.

E5.justification: Both versions specify seeds 2024, 2025 and 2026 and report the same per-run results, means and standard deviations in Table 16. The statistical-stability discussion is retained.

E6.justification: Tables 1 and 9 revise several baseline results, including average MSE for Time-LLM/ETTh1 (0.448 to 0.409), TimeMOE/Weather (0.288 to 0.256) and Time-CMA/ECL (0.185 to 0.174), and remove TimeMOE/ECL entries. Table 11 changes SE-LLM's M4-to-M3 Yearly SMAPE from 13.692 to 15.692. Table 9 also changes iTransformer's ECL-720 MAE from 0.294 to 0.204. Other experimental results are retained.

T1.justification: Eq. (7) revises the mathematical definition of GA by replacing C with DA, which is distinct under DA = C - DC. No new theorem, proof or substantive complexity derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about semantic alignment, temporal adaptation, forecasting superiority and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: The anomaly-modeling and generalization interpretations remain unchanged. The discussion and limitations retain the same qualifications, including omitting Time-Adapter in Llama short-term/zero-shot experiments and excluding Llama from long-term forecasting.

D1.justification: v6 adds a code repository address. Appendix B.2 newly identifies TimeMixer++ as a reconstruction, names baseline results adopted from AutoTimes, and describes selecting other baselines' best input lengths. Section 4.3 specifies a shared hardware/software environment, and Algorithm 7 clarifies output shape and indexing. These are documentation additions, not demonstrated experimental changes.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. Bibliographic changes, including restoring Qin et al.'s 2017 title, concern metadata rather than new related work.

P1.justification: v6 adds numbered sections and lettered appendices, changes author ordering/header text, corrects terminology and pseudocode labels, and expands the baseline-provenance paragraph. Most prose and the narrative order remain intact.

P2.justification: The entire document changes from two columns to a single-column conference layout, substantially resizing and repositioning figures, tables, equations and algorithms. Figure 4 gains a side-by-side caption, and table spacing and caption details change. The same six figures and sixteen tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v6 improves transparency through the code address and baseline provenance, corrects several summary/full-table discrepancies, and repairs the gated-fusion formula. These are useful but limited gains. A new inconsistency offsets some benefit: Table 9 changes iTransformer's ECL-720 MAE to 0.204 while retaining the 0.258 average, although the displayed values now average 0.235. The experimental scope and supporting analyses remain unchanged.
